meta.parties: Chelliah Et Al. v. Kuttapitiye Tea and Rubber Co

rules.statement: A mala fide possessor is not entitled to compensation for useful improvements.
rules.supporting_quote: "Whatever their position may be after their purchases of 1920 and 1921 I cannot see how it is possible to treat the possession prior thereto as other than mala fide. The plantation may be a useful but cannot be considered a necessary improvement, and it is settled law in Ceylon that a mala fide possessor is not entitled to compensation for useful improvements."
